evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI, the leading generative AI firm, expected its 2024 losses (about $5B) to exceed its 2024 revenue ($3.7B). That fits 'loses so much more money than it makes'.

unresolved_gaps: The primary Anthropic S-1 on sec.gov returned HTTP 403. Anthropic's 2024 operating loss comes from a secondary summary of the filing's table.
OpenAI's 2024 figures come from press reports of company documents, not audited statements.
Big tech firms (Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Meta) do not report generative AI profit or loss separately, so their part cannot be measured.
